specification_metadata.title: Keelmark Cabal packaging gate — normative pack ledger

packaging_build.package_version_alignment: every Cabal package version field (keelmark-core, keelmark-report, and keelmark) must equal edition-policy.package_version
packaging_build.stream_profile_rule: both keelmark-core and keelmark-report library stanzas must compile with cpp-options -DKEELMARK_GATE_V2; a build that omits the define on either library silently emits the retired tide-era stream and report formatting
packaging_build.compat_trees: directories named compat under any workspace package are the retired 8.10 audit trail only; hs-source-dirs for shipped libraries must list src alone and must not name compat

restored_modules.Keelmark.Scan: must exist at packages/keelmark-core/src/Keelmark/Scan.hs; implement event_pipeline exactly — retract rows strike earlier matching events during parse, kN is type-strict (a string-typed kN is malformed), the audit window is inclusive on both boundary dates, and dedup keeps the highest kN — the compat copy ignores retract rows, coerces quoted kN, closes the window before its end date, and keeps the first duplicate reading
restored_modules.Keelmark.Classify: must exist at packages/keelmark-core/src/Keelmark/Classify.hs; implement calibration.base_eff_tenths half-up tenths, classification inclusive >= thresholds, metrics.timestamp_padding (hour and second only), and metrics.dominant_peer Z-A tie-break — the compat copy uses banker's round, strict >, full HMS padding, and A-Z ties
restored_modules.Keelmark.Emit: must exist at packages/keelmark-report/src/Keelmark/Emit.hs; implement schemas/formatting from this ledger including bare coverage_pct, block_row_key_order with dominant_peer before load_index, and gate_seal.txt ending with exactly two newlines — the compat copy quotes coverage_pct, swaps those two block keys, and emits a single trailing newline

packaging_build.project_local_overrides: cabal.project.local must not undefine KEELMARK_GATE_V2 (no -UKEELMARK_GATE_V2 in ghc-options); delete or rewrite any local override that strips the gate profile
packaging_build.offline_bounds: dependency version bounds and cabal.project constraints must solve against the preinstalled package database with no Hackage fetches

skip_rules.brace_cycle: defined by the brace_cycle_quarantine section; evaluated only for blocks surviving the four earlier reasons
skip_rules.suppress_hit: block name listed in suppress-blocks.json names array (the alert_mute array is NOT a suppress list; muted blocks are measured normally)
skip_rules.abi_miss: edition-policy.edition_abi != pack-contract.required_edition_abi; this deferral guards future drift — gate sign-off requires edition_abi corrected to the contract value so no abi_miss rows ship
skip_rules.pin_mismatch: block_pins[name] string != roster row package_rev for that name
skip_rules.empty_shard: zero usable events remain after the full event pipeline (parse, audit-window filter, dedup); missing shard file counts as empty

overlay_shards.concatenation: when present, overlay lines are processed after every base shard line, as one continuous stream; non-blank lines from both files count toward event_lines_total

retract_rows.shape: kind retract with ts and peer (kN not required); type-strict on the fields present
retract_rows.rule: a retract row removes every event accepted earlier in the stream (base or prior overlay lines) whose ts and peer both match; events appearing after the retract are unaffected
retract_rows.position: retraction happens during parse, before the window filter and dedup, so retracted events never reach any counter or measurement
retract_rows.no_match: a retract matching nothing is a silent no-op
retract_rows.never_usable: retract rows are never events themselves
retract_rows.counter: retracted_total sums removed events across measured blocks only

parse.type_strict: kN must be a JSON number and ts/peer/kind JSON strings; a string-typed kN makes the line malformed
parse.unknown_fields: extra fields on an event line are permitted and ignored

window_filter.rule: keep events whose calendar date (first 10 characters of the raw ts) is within pack-contract.audit_window start..end, both inclusive; out-of-window events never influence measurement
window_filter.counter: window_dropped_total counts parsed-but-out-of-window events across measured blocks only

dedup.rule: events sharing an identical (ts, peer, kind) triple collapse to a single event keeping the highest kN
dedup.counter: dedup_dropped_total counts collapsed duplicates across measured blocks only

amendments.eligibility: only rows with status ratified ever apply; draft and revoked rows apply nothing
amendments.supersession: a ratified row is void when its seq appears in the supersedes array of any ratified row carrying a higher seq; void rows apply nothing
amendments.application_order: surviving ratified rows apply in ascending seq order regardless of file order; a later row overwrites an earlier row touching the same target

targets.warn_kN: replaces the contract's global warn_kN; zone overrides are untouched by amendments
targets.class_gains.<class>: replaces that single class gain in the contract's gain table
targets.alert_mute_add: adds the value block name to the alert_mute set

amendments.timing: the amended contract and mute set are in force before the candidate walk, measurement, classification, and alerting; raw pack-contract values that an amendment touches are dead once amended

brace_cycle_quarantine.graph: vertices are candidates that survive suppress_hit, abi_miss, pin_mismatch, and empty_shard; a directed edge runs from each vertex to every braced partner that is also a vertex
brace_cycle_quarantine.rule: every vertex lying on any directed cycle, including a self-brace, defers with reason brace_cycle
brace_cycle_quarantine.ordering: brace_cycle is the fifth and final skip precedence reason, evaluated after empty_shard
brace_cycle_quarantine.counters: usable_events_total, window_dropped_total, and dedup_dropped_total accrue only for blocks that remain measured after brace_cycle quarantine; event_lines_total still counts every candidate's non-blank lines
brace_cycle_quarantine.uplift: brace_cycle-deferred partners contribute nothing to surviving blocks' uplift

calibration.gain_source: pack-contract.class_gains keyed by the roster cell_class
calibration.base_eff_tenths: floor(max_kN * gain * 10 + 0.5) held as integer tenths, where max_kN is the highest raw kN among pipeline-surviving events (half-up rounding to one decimal)

brace_uplift.source: each roster row carries a directional braces array of partner block names
brace_uplift.rule: uplift_tenths = sum over braced partners that are themselves measured of floor(partner_base_eff_tenths / 50); partners contribute their BASE tenths (pre-uplift), computed in a single pass so ordering never matters
brace_uplift.excluded_partners: deferred, suppressed, or unknown partner names contribute nothing
brace_uplift.note: a muted partner is still measured and still contributes

calibration.eff_max_kN: (base_eff_tenths + uplift_tenths) / 10, emitted with exactly one decimal digit
calibration.note: classification and load_index consume the final uplifted eff_max_kN, never the raw maximum and never the pre-uplift base

classification.CRITICAL: eff_max_kN >= critical_kN (as amended) OR any pipeline-surviving event has kind escalate
classification.WARN: not CRITICAL AND eff_max_kN >= the block's effective warn threshold
classification.effective_warn_threshold: pack-contract.zone_overrides[zone].warn_kN when the contract defines an override for the block's roster zone, else the amended global warn_kN; zone overrides outrank both amendments and the raw contract global

metrics.sample_count: count of pipeline-surviving events (post window filter and dedup)
metrics.max_kN: highest raw kN among pipeline-surviving events, emitted as JSON number
metrics.eff_max_kN: calibrated value per the calibration section, emitted with exactly one decimal digit
metrics.dominant_peer: peer with the highest surviving-event count; ties break Z-A (lexicographically greatest peer wins)
metrics.last_tension_at_selection: among surviving events, choose the event whose raw ts string is lexicographically greatest; emit padded form of that raw ts
metrics.timestamp_padding: pad hour and second fields to two digits; leave minute field unpadded (example raw 2025-06-01T9:5:3Z emits 2025-06-01T09:5:03Z)
metrics.sort_key_raw_ts: inventory sort uses the selected event raw unpadded ts string, not the padded emission

alerts.include_when: classification is CRITICAL or WARN AND load_index >= pack-contract.min_alert_index AND block not listed in suppress-blocks.alert_mute
alerts.mute_rule: blocks in alert_mute stay fully measured in the inventory; rows that met the alert criteria but were muted increment alerts_muted instead of appearing in tension_alerts.json

blocks: classification order CRITICAL then WARN then STABLE
bucket_name_lists: critical, warn, stable arrays list measured names only

pack_inventory.json.deferred_field_note: top-level deferred is an array of deferred block names only; full name/reason rows live in deferred.json

summary.json.event_lines_total: count of non-blank shard lines across all candidates (measured and deferred), including malformed and noise
summary.json.usable_events_total: count of pipeline-surviving events across measured blocks only
summary.json.retracted_total: count of events removed by overlay retract rows across measured blocks only
summary.json.coverage_pct: round_half_up_2dp(100 * measured_count / candidate_count) emitted as a bare JSON number, never a quoted string, with exactly two decimal digits (example: 65.38 not "65.38"); round_half_up_2dp(value) = floor(value * 100 + 0.5) / 100
summary.json.inventory_sig: FNV-1a 64-bit hash of the final pack_inventory.json file bytes, emitted as a 16-character lowercase zero-padded hex JSON string; offset basis 14695981039346656037, prime 1099511628211, arithmetic modulo 2^64, byte order exactly as written to disk

gate_seal.txt.bundle_sig: FNV-1a 64-bit hash (same constants and hex emission as inventory_sig) over the concatenated exact bytes of pack_inventory.json, tension_alerts.json, deferred.json, and summary.json in that order, each file exactly as written to disk including its trailing-newline polarity
gate_seal.txt.ending: the single seal line is followed by exactly two newline characters

formatting.numeric_types: every numeric field in every deliverable emits as a bare JSON number, never a quoted string; counters and load_index emit as integers without decimal points, kN metrics with exactly one decimal digit, coverage_pct with exactly two
formatting.emission_order_note: pack_inventory.json bytes must be final before inventory_sig is computed for summary.json and gate_seal.txt
